describe.runs: Runs for {minMs} ms with no error
describe.pin-toggles: Pin {pin} switches on and off, {periodMs} ms per cycle
describe.pwm: Pin {pin} has a duty of {duty} at {atMs} ms
describe.servo: The servo on pin {pin} is at {deg} degrees at {atMs} ms
describe.responds: Pin {pin} responds within {withinMs} ms of the {input}
describe.code: The code has what the task asks for
describe.no-errors: The circuit and the code have no errors
describe.hidden: A check the teacher keeps hidden

hint.runs: Run the program. It has to keep going without an error.
hint.serial: Open the serial monitor and print the text the check looks for.
hint.pin-level: Make the program drive pin {pin} to the right level at that time.
hint.pin-toggles: The pin has to switch on and off again and again. Look at the delays in the code.
hint.pwm: Write a value to pin {pin} that gives the duty the check asks for.
hint.tone: Play the note on pin {pin} at the frequency the check asks for.
hint.servo: Move the servo to an angle inside the range.
hint.responds: Make the pin react to the input in time.
hint.code: The code lacks something the task asks for, or holds something it should not.
hint.pin-volts: Put a meter on that pin. Check the wiring and the values of the parts.
hint.part-amps: Too little or too much current? Check the resistor and the wiring.
hint.pin-frequency: Run the circuit and watch the signal on a scope. Change the timing until it is in range.
hint.no-errors: Open the Problems panel and fix every error.

detail.no-source: The project has no code to run.
detail.unsupported-language: This language cannot be checked here.
detail.refused: The circuit could not be built.
detail.no-program: There is no code to run.
detail.no-engine: This program cannot be checked here.

bar.label: Assignment
bar.notRun: Nothing is checked yet. Press Check my work.
bar.stale: You changed the project after this check. Check again.
bar.failed: The checks could not run. Try again.

handIn.title: Hand in your work
handIn.lede: Your project, the results of the checks and a hash go into one file. Your teacher opens it and runs the checks again, so the results here are not what counts.
handIn.name: Your name
handIn.nameRequired: Enter your name so your teacher knows whose work this is.
handIn.downloaded: Saved {name}. Send it to your teacher.
handIn.copied: Code copied. Paste it where your teacher asked for it.
handIn.copyFailed: The code could not be copied. Download the file instead.
handIn.failed: The checks could not run. Try again.

make.title: Make an assignment
make.lede: The student gets a copy of this project, your instructions and the checks in one link. No account and no server are needed.
make.instructionsHint: What the student should build. Plain text.

starter.unwired: The same parts, without the wires
starter.board-only: Only the board and the breadboard

make.lockedNone: This project has no parts to lock.
make.checksLede: A check passes or fails when the student presses Check my work. The checks of your Checks tab are included.
make.hiddenField: Hide this check from the student
make.invalid: This check is not complete. Check the part, the pin and the range.
make.copied: Link copied. Anyone who has it can open the assignment.
make.copyFailed: The link could not be copied. Select it and copy it by hand.
make.tooLarge: This assignment is too large for a link ({kb} KB). Save it as a file, or share it from the server.
make.saved: Saved {name}. Students open it in iynk.
make.serverFailed: The server could not share it. Save the file instead.
make.serverDone: Shared. Students open the link and make their copy.
make.failed: The assignment could not be made: {reason}

open.failed: This assignment link does not work. Ask your teacher for a new one.

grade.title: Grade submissions
grade.lede: Open the assignment, then add the files your students handed in. Every submission is graded here by running the checks again.
grade.paste: Or paste an assignment link or code
grade.invalid: This is not an assignment. Check the link, the code or the file.
grade.hashBad: The file was changed after the student made it
grade.mismatch: The results on the student's device differ from the ones found here
grade.detail: Results of running the checks again
